# Task Manager Project Instructions

## Project Overview
This is a React + Vite Task Manager application with advanced features including categories, priorities, tags, filters, and local storage.

## Tech Stack
- React 18
- Vite
- React Icons
- date-fns
- react-hot-toast

## Features
- Add/Edit/Delete tasks
- Custom categories
- Priorities (Low, Medium, High, Urgent)
- Customizable tags
- Multiple filters
- Due dates with visual reminders
- localStorage persistence
- Text search
- Dark/light mode
- Statistics dashboard
